{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: are there any rows with revenue '999999.99'? (Re-check)
filtered = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of rows with revenue '999999.99': {len(filtered)}")

# Check if any completed orders have this value
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders with revenue '999999.99': {len(completed[completed['revenue'] == '999999.99'])}")

# Confirm that revenue is string with commas
print("Sample of revenue values:", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any revenue values contain commas (e.g., '1,234.56')
print("Revenue values with commas:", sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())"}
